entities.name: Philogonius of Antioch
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philogonius was a lawyer and an early Bishop of Antioch who came to be considered a saint. He opposed Arianism when that heresy emerged in Alexandria, Egypt. His feast day is 20 December.
